Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

directory to confirm that maxmemory-policy is configured to volatile-lru and verify that our client connection pool limits are set to twenty thousand connections. next inspect sentinel dot py in the queries during momentary network partitions between edge gateways and core database pods. the reliability engineering team will run automated load tests simulating fifteen thousand transactions per second against the staging cluster to ensure latency remains under twenty-five milliseconds across ninety-nine percent of requests. regarding sentinel cluster quorum we must verify that all three sentinel pods run on independent availability zones and configure down-after-milliseconds to five thousand milliseconds across each node. the client connection pools in auth service and order worker must initialize backoff retries using full jitter with a base interval of one hundred milliseconds capped at two thousand milliseconds. incident coordinators should also review runbook documentation in docs slash runbooks slash redis underscore failover dot md to ensure that emergency manual failover procedures accurately reflect the latest cluster endpoint topology. we must also confirm that schedule an operational readiness review for thursday afternoon with the infrastructure engineering manager to audit all configuration diffs and approve deployment to production.", "output": "Team, we need to address the Redis cluster cache stampede that occurred during this morning's flash sale. First, please check @config/redis.conf in the config directory to confirm that maxmemory-policy is configured to volatile-lru and verify that our client connection pool limits are set to 20,000 connections. Next, inspect @cluster/sentinel.py in the cluster package and check file reference @services/cache_manager.ts in the services directory. The primary incident trigger was a sudden cache invalidation cascade when 5,000 concurrent checkout workers attempted to recalculate inventory balances simultaneously after key expiration. To prevent recurrent stampedes, we must implement probabilistic early expiration using xfetch algorithm with a beta value of 1.2 and set background refresh timeouts to 5 seconds. In addition, update @cluster/sentinel.py to ensure that automatic sentinel failover triggers after three consecutive unresponsive ping probes spaced 2 seconds apart rather than the current 30-second timeout. Do not disable master-replica replication sync under any circumstances during failover testing. The database team lead requires that we verify fallback read throughput against read replicas and establish automated Grafana alerts when Redis memory fragmentation ratio exceeds 1.5. Also confirm that all worker threads log Redis connection timeouts to Datadog with structured error tags including client IP address, tenant ID, and operation latency before concluding the remediation cycle. Furthermore, our edge caching layer must enforce a minimum time to live of 120 seconds on inventory metadata to avoid upstream Redis queries during momentary network partitions between edge gateways and core database pods. The reliability engineering team will run automated load tests simulating 15,000 transactions per second against the staging cluster to ensure latency remains under 25 milliseconds across 99% of requests. Regarding sentinel cluster quorum, we must verify that all three sentinel pods run on independent availability zones and configure down-after-milliseconds to 5,000 milliseconds across each node. The client connection pools in auth service and order worker must initialize backoff retries using full jitter with a base interval of 100 milliseconds capped at 2,000 milliseconds. Incident coordinators should also review runbook documentation in @docs/runbooks/redis_failover.md to ensure that emergency manual failover procedures accurately reflect the latest cluster endpoint topology. We must also confirm that Redis persistent append-only files are synced every second on replica disks and verify that background rewrite tasks do not trigger memory allocation spikes during active peak traffic windows. Finally, schedule an operational readiness review for Thursday afternoon with the infrastructure engineering manager to audit all configuration diffs and approve deployment to production."}]
